headline.purpose: Names the active workspace or primary continuation task.

body.purpose: UI body at 14px; long-form areas may follow the user reading size.

label.purpose: Compact controls, metadata, counts, and source kinds.

shadows.name: composer
shadows.purpose: Separates a floating composer from reading content.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and small state feedback.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Short state transitions that settle quickly.

components.name: Workspace Primary Button
components.description: The active workspace color identifies the page's main command.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--workspace-accent, #0d6b5d); border-radius: 5px; color: #fff; background: var(--workspace-accent, #0d6b5d); font: 600 12px/1.4 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(.9); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--workspace-accent, #0d6b5d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet raised command for adjacent actions.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #d1d8d4); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--text-primary, #1d2420); background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); font: 600 12px/1.4 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--workspace-accent, #0d6b5d); background: var(--workspace-accent-soft, #deeee9); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--workspace-accent, #0d6b5d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Activity Item
components.description: A fixed square navigation target with workspace identity.
components.css: .ds-activity-item { display: grid; width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: #9a6500; background: #f3ead7; font: 600 10px/1 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-activity-item:hover { background: #e1e7e4; } .ds-activity-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9a6500; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Continuation Index Row
components.description: Chronological work entry with order, source, title, excerpt, kind, and time.
components.css: .ds-index-row { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 66px; padding: 10px 6px 10px 0; grid-template-columns: 37px 28px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-default, #d1d8d4); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #dfe4e1); color: var(--text-primary, #1d2420); background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-index-number, .ds-index-row time { color: var(--text-muted, #6b7770); font: 400 10px/1.4 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-index-source { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 5px; background: #deeee9; } .ds-index-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-index-copy strong { font: 640 13px/1.4 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-index-copy small { color: var(--text-muted, #6b7770); font: 400 11px/1.4 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-index-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #e1e7e4); } .ds-index-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0d6b5d; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact raised field with semantic focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-text-field { height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #d1d8d4); border-radius: 5px; color: var(--text-primary, #1d2420); background: var(--surface-raised, #fff); font: 400 12px/1.4 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-text-field:hover { border-color: var(--text-muted, #6b7770); } .ds-text-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--workspace-accent, #0d6b5d); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Mnemora uses the visual logic of an index: narrow rails locate work, ordered rows preserve chronology, and workspace colors identify context without tinting whole pages. The surrounding shell stays quiet so conversation, notes, PDFs, and study material can carry the user's attention.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral mineral surfaces with clear one-pixel boundaries.
Five stable workspace colors used for location, action, source, and real progress.
Compact navigation and controls around spacious content and reading fields.
Information-bearing rails, timestamps, source labels, and loading skeletons.

rules.name: The Useful Structure Rule
rules.body: A divider, index number, color, or rail must communicate location, order, source, status, or progress.

rules.name: The Workspace Identity Rule
rules.body: Use the active workspace color for the current navigation item, its primary action, source markers, index rails, and truthful progress. Do not spread it across the page background.

rules.name: The Stable Chrome Rule
rules.body: Reading preferences may change prose, but must not change navigation, controls, tables, labels, or panel geometry.

rules.name: The Stable Geometry Rule
rules.body: Fixed-format controls, rails, and panels keep explicit dimensions so loading, hover, long labels, and state changes cannot shift the shell.

dos: Do preserve the neutral shell and fixed five-color workspace mapping.
Do keep status meaning paired with text, icons, shape, or position.
Do use Lucide icons, visible focus states, bounded lists, and stable skeleton dimensions.
Do let long-form content breathe while keeping navigation and utilities compact.
donts: Don't build card walls, nested cards, marketing heroes, glass surfaces, or decorative gradients.
Don't use workspace colors as success or failure colors.
Don't let reading font settings resize application chrome.
Don't add decorative animation, gamification, or color without information.
